criteria.requirement: Add Cache.resize(maxsize) for built-in policies. Validate a nonnegative real int/float excluding bool/NaN; allow positive infinity. Perform normal expiry cleanup for timed caches, then evict through their original popitem policy until currsize fits, update maxsize and return a tuple of capacity-evicted pairs (not expired pairs). Preserve weighted sizing, growth/no-op behavior, subsequent insertion semantics and zero capacity. Validation must happen before any cleanup or mutation; do not rebuild caches or reset policy history.
